The complexity of weakly recognizing morphisms

Fleischer, Lukas; Kufleitner, Manfred

RAIRO. Theoretical Informatics and Applications, Tome 53 (2019) no. 1 p. 1-17

Résumé : ...

Weakly recognizing morphisms from free semigroups onto finite semigroups are a classical way for defining the class of ω-regular languages, i.e., a set of infinite words is weakly recognizable by such a morphism if and only if it is accepted by some Büchi automaton. We study the descriptional complexity of various constructions and the computational complexity of various decision problems for weakly recognizing morphisms. The constructions we consider are the conversion from and to Büchi automata, the conversion into strongly recognizing morphisms, as well as complementation. ...
